root.label: Trump signs childhood vaccine recommendation executive order

events.label: Trump signs childhood vaccine recommendation executive order

slots.name: recommended vaccines
slots.sentence: The order reduces the current recommendation of 18 vaccines for children down to 11, which puts it almost in line with the World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations.

slots.name: signing date
slots.sentence: US President Donald Trump signed another executive order on Monday, August 10, 2026: "Delivering gold standard childhood vaccine recommendations for Americans."
